items.stem: An accountant is offered a gift by a client that could influence their judgement. Which fundamental ethical principle is most directly threatened?

options.rationale: Correct: a gift creating bias threatens objectivity, the principle of not allowing undue influence to override professional judgement.
Confidentiality concerns disclosure of information, not gifts influencing judgement.
Competence concerns skill and knowledge, not bias from gifts.
Timeliness is not one of the fundamental ethical principles.

items.explanation: Correct: a gift creating bias threatens objectivity, the principle of not allowing undue influence to override professional judgement.

items.stem: For a simple contract to be legally binding, which of the following is normally required?

options.text: Offer, acceptance, consideration and intention to create legal relations
options.rationale: Correct: these are the essential elements of a valid simple contract.

options.text: Only a verbal promise with no other element
options.rationale: A bare promise without consideration or intention is not generally enforceable.
Most simple contracts need no registration.

options.text: A payment of at least the market value
options.rationale: Consideration need not be adequate, only sufficient; market value is not required.

items.explanation: Correct: these are the essential elements of a valid simple contract.
items.domain_ref: General principles of the legal system and contract law

items.stem: Select TWO features commonly associated with good corporate governance.

options.text: A balance of executive and independent non-executive directors on the board
options.rationale: Correct: board balance and independence are governance features.

options.text: An effective audit committee overseeing financial reporting and controls
options.rationale: Correct: an audit committee strengthens oversight and accountability.

options.text: Concentrating all power in a single unaccountable individual
options.rationale: Concentrating unchecked power is contrary to good governance.
Transparency to shareholders is a governance aim, not concealment.

options.text: Paying no attention to internal control
options.rationale: Sound internal control is central to good governance.

items.explanation: Correct: board balance and independence are governance features.
items.domain_ref: Corporate governance and corporate social responsibility
